questions.question: At which ground did Iinyathi record their 'Highest Total' (List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Kimberley Oval — highest total of 345, against Heat on 2015/10/17.

questions.question: In head-to-head T20 meetings, who has the edge, Knights or Titans?
Who won CSA Women's Cricketer of the Year in the 2017 season?
Who has achieved the century and 3 wickets in a match double more times, Alicia Smith or Susan Benade?
questions.explanation: Alicia Smith: 1 times. Susan Benade: 2 times.

questions.question: At Willowmoore Park Main Oval, who holds the record for 'Most Runs' (List A)?
questions.explanation: Adele van Eck holds it with 216.

questions.question: At which ground did K Tjiane record their career-best innings (54, List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Polokwane Oval, against Limpopo Lillies on 2013/11/23.
